accepted.reason: Memory exhaustion while validating an oversized constrained collection. The only fixed release is zod 4.6.6, a major version: every schema in the server (about 400 files) and zod-to-json-schema, which builds each agent tool's input schema, would have to move together. Exposure here is bounded: the global JSON parser stops a body at 100 kB before any schema sees it, every webhook body is capped at 128 kB to 1 MB, and the larger upload parsers are mounted inside their routers after the sign-in and role checks, so only a signed-in account can send a large body. Move to zod 4 as its own change, with the check suite green before and after.
